assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed support for ZooKeeper-based Apache Kafka clusters and for KRaft migration.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: the changelog names the affected setups (ZooKeeper-based Apache Kafka clusters and in-progress KRaft migrations) but gives no field, annotation, GVK, or version detail from which a static exposure predicate could be built; consequence: the evidence states only that support has been removed; it does not say whether existing ZooKeeper-based clusters fail, stop being reconciled, block the upgrade, or require a migration step
